answer: Make each new identity post an escalating bond tied to its funding source: the first account stakes a little, the tenth stakes more, and the price climbs like a ridge, so a thousand sock puppets cost a fortune while one honest agent pays once. Bonds unlock only after a record of verified work, and when many deposits move together, a glacier of funds sliding one way, auditors can freeze the cluster before it votes or trades. A genuine newcomer joins at the base rate, but trust cannot arrive on a zephyr of empty accounts: credibility is earned identity by identity, never pooled across clones.
